annotations.exact_quote: Based on the low-rank property of HSIs, the patchwise low-rank matrix approximation (LRMA) is established.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确以HSI低秩性质为基础建立分块低秩矩阵近似，低秩结构是方法核心。

annotations.exact_quote: Due to the low-dimensional property of clean hyperspectral images (HSIs), many low-rank-based methods have been proposed to denoise HSIs.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文研究对象为高光谱图像（HSI），任务为HSI去噪。

annotations.exact_quote: In this paper, a noise-adjusted iterative low-rank matrix approximation (NAILRMA) method is proposed for HSI denoising.
annotations.reason_zh: HSI去噪旨在从含噪观测恢复干净高光谱图像，输出为恢复后的数据。
